What degraded

  • Shipped at the round cap at 6.97, 1.03 under the 8.0 top rung. The art median 6.8 is under the craft floor of 8.5 and the floor stood down at the cap.
  • Frames 3 and 7, the two count frames, read as flat charts to all three judges in every round. Frame 3 is audition bound and was never repaired.
  • Frame 7's '860 compute nodes' label sits 23 px from the left edge, inside the 80 px margin, after round 3 bled the field. Machine QA warned; the frame ships as scored.
  • Frame 9's headline 'Frontera is dark. The work moved.' was charged as unbounded by the integrity judge in rounds 2 and 3. Its dek bounds it to one lab.
  • UT Southwestern is unplaced because no fetched source states its city, and story and stakes held at 5.5 to 6.5 in every round.

Named here rather than left out. A run that quietly ships less than it planned teaches nobody anything.

Post this

Upload the PDF to LinkedIn as a document, title it 64 Frontera CPU nodes, 8 Vista GPU nodes, almost the same speed by one lab's account, paste the post copy under it, then paste the first comment within a minute of posting.

carousel.pdf   contact sheet   the site

1. The post copy

A Frontera node held two Xeons.

Jose Rizo-Rey's lab at UT Southwestern Medical Center typically ran a 5.3 million atom simulation at 43 nanoseconds per day on 64 of those nodes. Frontera was retired in October after more than eight million jobs.

On Vista at UT Austin, eight GPU nodes gave Rizo-Rey "almost the same speed." Most Vista nodes run NVIDIA's GH200, a Grace CPU paired with a Hopper GPU.

His account names software and people. He says the speed "required a lot of optimizations with GROMACS, with the help of people here at TACC." One lab's account, not a benchmark.

Frontera's successor Horizon is in its first phase of early operations. Its power infrastructure is complete and its AI hardware is going in. Who will tune the code for the labs that run on it?

#TACC #UTSouthwestern #UTAustin

The machine changed itself

  • The kit gained a data hall (12bb6eaf)
    A server rack is now a solid panelled enclosure with lit edges and dark empty slots, the judges' named fix for the wire cages charged on no. 73. The week's top theme, a primitive where a kit model belongs, named on 6 of 6 runs.
  • Count frames are shot at a raking three quarter (03f80d8b)
    The art doctrine had ordered a straight-down plan for any count. A census found 22 of 53 plan reliefs charged as charts against 21 of 136 spatial frames.
  • panel_ready checks bytes, not file times (b28c1a34)
    Reverting an edit to the reviewed bytes no longer forces a re-render or a hand-set file time.
  • For a maintainer
    The routine still says 'parallel projection for any quantity', TXT.contact draws a pale plane under a spotlight, and a GATE_LESSONS entry is owed for the panel_ready change.

Every change is logged in ledger/carousel/upgrades.json.
